folkways_create.ponder.create_handoff.he: Handing a Create schematic to the colony
folkways_create.ponder.create_handoff.te: With Create installed, a schematic you have put in place with Create's own tools can go to the colony instead of to a schematicannon.
Hold the schematic, and the colony's book in your other hand.
The schematic's tools have one more among them: Hand Off, marked with the colony book. Choose it and right click.
A small window asks one thing: what to do with cells the blueprint leaves empty. Leave what stands there, which it starts on, or dig it out.
Place the build order. It is filed where the schematic stands, turned and mirrored the way you set it.
From there it is a build order like any other: residents raise it, and it shows on the Building page. It is never raised at once, not even in creative.
folkways_create.ponder.dispatch.header: Dispatch: order from a Create package network
folkways_create.ponder.dispatch.text_1: A package network built with Create: stock behind a packager and a stock link, and a Stock Ticker to order from. The colony orders from it only by what it ships on: every packager hands its parcels to frogports beside it, all on one chain net, turning and in one dimension; or to a postbox beside it, set to a station. Should that stop being so, the colony orders nothing until it is put right, though residents still take from its containers by hand. Let nothing else take from those packagers, or orders go astray.
folkways_create.ponder.dispatch.text_2: With the book pointing, left click the stock link or the Stock Ticker: the colony takes the network on. Left-click a frogport or a chain conveyor: the colony takes that whole chain net on. Left-click a postbox: the colony takes that postbox on, and sends by it only aboard trains it has taken on. The same click gives each back. The network orders only once what it ships on is the colony's too.
folkways_create.ponder.dispatch.text_3: A network locked in Create can only be handed over by someone allowed to run it.
folkways_create.ponder.dispatch.text_4: A Stock Ticker is a desk. A resident with the Dispatch trade sits on a seat beside it, on the same level or one below, and keeps it.
folkways_create.ponder.dispatch.text_5: The colony only orders from a network with its own keeper at the desk. With nobody there, the stock is counted but out of reach.
folkways_create.ponder.dispatch.text_6: Every Package Frogport on a chain net the colony holds is a pick-up point, except the ones beside the network's packagers, where parcels set out, and the ones over a container, which empty what they catch into it. So is every postbox the colony holds that one of its trains runs to. The colony sends to whichever point is handiest. A point whose address is exactly * or contains any of { } , \ is never used by the colony on its own.
folkways_create.ponder.dispatch.text_7: When the colony needs goods the network has in stock, it sends for them to a pick-up point. A hauler waits for the parcels and takes out what was ordered.
folkways_create.ponder.dispatch.text_8: Parcels nobody here is waiting for are emptied as well, so strays do not fill the pick-up point.
folkways_create.ponder.dispatch.text_9: The Dispatch page lists the networks taken on, whether someone is at the desk, each pick-up point, and what is on the way.
folkways_create.ponder.elevator.header: Elevators: walk in, ride and walk out
folkways_create.ponder.elevator.text_1: Build and power a Create elevator: a glued cabin under an elevator pulley, a moving redstone contact and matching elevator contacts at the floors. Keep the shaft clear and provide walkable landings beside the cabin.
folkways_create.ponder.elevator.text_2: With the book pointing, left click the elevator pulley to take it into the colony. Residents can then plan routes between its floors, even while the cabin is elsewhere.
folkways_create.ponder.elevator.text_3: A resident walks to the landing and waits for the cabin. When it arrives, he walks into a free standing place. Capacity comes from the clear connected deck, with room left for passing; adding seats does not add capacity.
folkways_create.ponder.elevator.text_4: The elevator carries standing residents to their requested floors. At the stop they walk out onto the landing and continue to work or bed. Keep the entrances and exits clear.
folkways_create.ponder.elevator.text_5: A full cabin leaves the next resident waiting for a later trip. A stopped or overstressed drive cannot provide a ride; keep the pulley powered and its floor contacts reachable.
folkways_create.ponder.rail.header: Rail: give the colony a train to run
folkways_create.ponder.rail.text_1: Build and assemble a train with Create as usual. The colony can run it for you.
folkways_create.ponder.rail.text_2: With the colony book in your off hand, use a Train Schedule on the driver's seat of a train that has none. The train takes the schedule, and the colony takes the train on.
folkways_create.ponder.rail.text_3: An empty hand on the same seat, book still in the off hand, takes the schedule out and gives the train back.
folkways_create.ponder.rail.text_4: While the train stands at a station with its driver's seat empty, a resident with the Drive trade walks over and sits in it.
folkways_create.ponder.rail.text_5: Add Driver Seated to the stop's wait conditions, and the train waits there until every driver sent for has sat down.
folkways_create.ponder.rail.text_6: With a driver aboard, a train that calls at two or more stations and has a free seat is a way to get about. Residents on their way somewhere ride it from one of its stations to another.
folkways_create.ponder.rail.text_7: Add All Residents Alighted to a stop, and the train holds there until everyone getting off at that station is off.
folkways_create.ponder.rail.text_8: The Rail page lists each train taken on, its stations, whether it is running or at a stop, and when it has no driver.
